Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Suresh - 32 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Sanjay - 63 years, king, father
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
3. Ajay - 37 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Suresh stands in the court. Sanjay stands near him.]

Suresh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Suresh sits down on the throne.]

Sanjay: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Suresh unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Sanjay: "Suresh, look at this."

[Suresh drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Sanjay (gently): "No… this cannot be!"
